review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature eye part (PROPOSED): a chameleon-like scaly conical eye turret with a small gold-ringed pupil at its tip; shuts and reaches on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartEyeTurret_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartEyeTurret_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the aperture drawn shut over the pupil
the turret about 2.2 cm taller, reaching further out

part_rules.handles_note: H1_Blink is on EyeTurretCone; H2_Reach is on EyeTurretCone and the ball EyeTurret with the same name: the cone stretches and the ball rides up inside it by the same 2.2 cm.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a smooth, slightly convex cone 8.4 cm across and 6 cm out of the skin with a round aperture at its tip (gray_top), the ball sitting just inside it. H1_Blink puckers the aperture shut, H2_Reach stretches the turret about 2.2 cm taller with the ball riding up inside. Iterated: the first turret read as a beehive dome whose geometric ridges decimated into irregular terraces and whose aperture was a hexagon; the ridges are now in the normal map and the cone is decimated at a tighter 0.3 mm tolerance (668 triangles).
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: two finishes - turquoise skin of small domed granular tubercles in concentric ring bands, and through the aperture a glossy gold iris ring round a black pupil (the crop of mat_threequarter shows both). Iterated: the first scale shader read as cracked mud.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral rig the ring bands and tubercles read by soft grazing light, the gold ring is visible inside the shadowed aperture; no clipping.
review_notes.gate4_godot: unverified: not yet seen in the creature editor (more_parts_shots.gd)

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
